note: 243 held-out test nuclei from the 3 test mice (donor-A/B/C), never used in training. Chosen by label, never by model output: not typical accuracy.

selection.rule: 14 test nuclei per condition (17 plates, seed 0); irradiated: round(0.6 x 14) = 8 with nfoci >= 3, rest random; + the SOURCE.md example nuclei that are test nuclei. Chosen by label, never by model output (not typical accuracy).

storage.layout: gzip of nucleus after nucleus, row-major 128 x 128; 'offset' = index in file

circles.centroid: mean (row, col) of the part's pixels
circles.order: raster order of each part's first pixel (row-major scan; scipy.ndimage.label)

line.rule: our product rule (geometric line fit, no ground truth)

calibration.label: our product rule
calibration.constraint: X-ray val nuclei with a line <= 0.1
calibration.objective: max share of Fe val nuclei with a line; ties -> fewer X-ray lines, then least strict

line.pairs: if n(n-1)/2 <= 200: every pair (i < j, lexicographic); else 200 pairs: i = floor(u*n), j = floor(u*(n-1)), j += (j >= i)
line.best_pair: most inliers (distance <= 4 px), ties -> smaller sum of inlier distances, then the earlier pair
line.refit: PCA of the inliers (covariance / k); lam1 >= lam2
line.drawn: k >= min_inliers and score >= min_score of that detector (n >= 3)
line.points: the circles in the order above

probs.dose_band: [1 - s(d0), s(d0) - s(d1), s(d1)], s = sigmoid, d = dose_cum_logits
probs.lambda: exp(count_lograte) (model mean foci; not the displayed count)

reference: ref = onnxruntime CPU on the decoded bytes: circles [row, col, area_px] in 128x128 canvas pixels, line in canvas (row, col); out = stored model outputs (probabilities rounded to 5 dp)
